section.50: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah

50.name_native: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that:The Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to say: "A'udhu billahi minal-kufri wal-faqr. (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from Kufr and poverty.)" A man said: "Are they equal?" He said: "Yes
